{{Quote|This holoprojection was a gift from Queen Ressa of Drezzi to thank Darth Nyriss for her merciful treatment of the royal family when the Empire conquered their world. Her husband was executed, but the queen and her children were spared.|Sechel, to Scourge|<ref name="Revan" />}}
A '''resistance force''' [[Conquest of Drezzi|fought]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drezzi]]<ref name="Revan" /> sometime prior to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3954 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the beginning of ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' to [[3954 BBY]]. Since the story of [[Drezzi]] [[Conquest of Drezzi|conquest]] occurred prior to the novel's events, it can be concluded that it took place before that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] eventually conquered the world, and the [[Ressa's husband|husband]] of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Ressa]] of Drezzi was [[Death/Legends|executed]].<ref name="Revan" /> In 3954 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Sechel]] told the story of Drezzi's fall to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]].<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The resistance force of Drezzi was indirectly mentioned in the [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]].<ref name="Revan" />
